g.text: Prompt effects on identical checkpoint–draw states
This shows what happens when we change the instructions given to the LLM. Zero means the same gain as the normal prompt. Right of zero means more gain; left means less.
The lines show uncertainty. 'Focus' means the goal typed by the user. Asking for only the worst pair or minimal changes lowers the total gain here. That alone does not
tell us whether the advice is more useful to a person.
